why: Wave-1 spikes can refute signed contract text; fan-out must start from one amended contract, not fifteen local deviations. The lead cannot be raised per Issue, so the hard decisions are made by the tagged worker.
what: Fold each spike result into docs/v3/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/v3/DIRECTION.md and the concepts, add one section 14 row per outcome, repin changed contract files.
contract: docs/v3/ARCHITECTURE.md section 14 row format (Contract amendment | Change | Source, reason) and section 11 falsifiers (each 'refuted if' names the fallback). Inputs: docs/v3/spikes/{no-restyle,provider,synced,thin-skill,scroller,census,allow-padding,cn-breakpoints,lint-edges,hook-sync,controls-codegen,live-poller,token-surfaces,upstream-churn}.md. Insufficient contract: factory signal, reversible default, PR body says so. Frozen contracts are read-only.
change: For each input write one outcome (confirmed or refuted) in its concept section and one section 14 row; apply each refuted spike's stated fallback to the text; where a contract.ts or ports.ts changes, edit it and recompute its pin with shasum -a 256. Tables use |-| separators. The hard decisions go to a tagged worker: spawn the implementer subagent with `[opus: Decides how each refuted spike changes signed contract text before fan-out; the lead cannot be raised per Issue]` in its description. Ships with: check-contract-frozen as the guarantee (the amendment commit subject is what lets a pin change pass); no skill or lint change here.
commits: `docs:` commit for docs/v3; a separate package commit with subject `chore: contract amendment <topic>` for contract files and pins (required by check-contract-frozen). No attribution.
acceptance: Each of the 14 spike files is cited in docs/v3/ARCHITECTURE.md section 14 or in its concept's spike table with confirmed or refuted (grep -c per file name is at least 1).
bun packages/basalt-ui/scripts/check-contract-frozen.ts exits 0 and any changed contract file has a changed pin.
git log origin/master..HEAD --format=%s contains a subject starting 'chore: contract amendment' when a pin changed.
grep -rn '|---' docs/v3/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/v3/DIRECTION.md docs/v3/concepts returns nothing new.
bun packages/basalt-ui/scripts/check-agent-doc-drift.ts exits 0 and make check passes.
out_of_scope: Spikes not in this row's after list (table-fit, shell-frame, control-home, q3, q5-q8, f2, f3, epos probe, q2-map), implementation.
